Supported only if the backdoor stays at or above 90% attack success when the student is distilled on proxy data from other sources (natural images from a different dataset, synthetic renderings), if distilling on a subset of the original classes keeps it when the target class is included but removes it entirely when the target class is left out, and if the channels that drive the backdoor are ones ordinary clean images also use heavily, unlike the channels behind trigger backdoors.

Supported only if, for each of three backbones, it raises average exact match by at least 25% relative over normal decoding while raising throughput at least tenfold; if it beats lossless source-reuse acceleration, rule-based copy constraints and a learned pointer-style copy mechanism on average exact match; if it still adds accuracy on top of fine-tuning the model for the task; and if replacing the learned correction by fixed rules on the margin gives only marginal gains.
